confidence_notes: Food and drink estimates use a [restaurant price index](https://www.averagecostof.living/in/poland/gdansk/restaurants), a small [cocktail sample](https://www.expatistan.com/price/cocktail/gdansk), and a [local wine price guide](https://luggage24.pl/en/blog-en/is-gdansk-cheap/). Cocktail and wine estimates also reflect their price relationship to beer. July accommodation is a holistic estimate and varies substantially with location and demand.
comparable_city_reasoning: Kraków and other major Polish visitor cities provide a regional baseline, adjusted for Gdańsk's Baltic coast and July peak season.
